description: Bessell & Murphy (2012) revised UBVRI standard passbands, tabulated as normalised photonic (photon-counting) responses for synthetic photometry on the Johnson-Cousins system.
facility_description: Generic standard-system passbands, not tied to a single telescope; these are distributed through the CDS (Strasbourg) catalogue J/PASP/124/140.
notes: VizieR's rules say data are free for scientific use with citation of the original authors and publication, and that commercial use depends on the data origin; this catalogue comes from PASP (not AAS, not A&A) and its ReadMe states no copyright. Bessell (1990) is listed for context only: NJM's notes say these curves are the 2012 photonic set, not the 1990 energy-response passbands. The VizieR acknowledgement text is copied verbatim from the VizieR rules page; it is a request ('would be appreciated'). DetectorType unchanged (NJM already records photon).

licence.terms: "The data retrieved with VizieR are free of usage in a scientific context; however, as it is the usage in scientific publication, the original authors and publication references including the publisher have to be explicitely cited (see section Code of conduct of scientific research)."

acknowledgements.text: This research has made use of the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg, France (DOI : 10.26093/cds/vizier). The original description of the VizieR service was published in 2000, A&AS 143, 23

B.DetectorType_note: SVO's Generic/Bessell.B (captured 2025-11-17, 'Bessell B generic filter', no reference given) is a different array from NJM's (SVO/NJM ∝ λ^0.76, rms 0.013). NJM's curve is Bessell & Murphy (2012, PASP 124, 140; doi:10.1086/664083) Table 1, their 'normalized photon-counting passbands'. The labels describe different curves, so there is no conflict.
